unit_policy: Preserve source records until explicit final-text deduplication; retain source text and provenance in every restricted intermediate layer.

stages.operation: group exact source strings and retain a deterministic canonical contribution
apply ordered reviewed bracket and structural metadata rules
apply reviewed literal and regex rules without deleting the source layer
apply an explicit character map and Unicode normalization
apply separately identified regex rules for date stamps, truncation markers, and acquisition residue
record explicit non-title, non-CJK, or long-form/forum exclusions; never silently drop rows
apply only reviewed exact spans after source-match and overlap checks
recalculate CJK semantic length after cleaning and de-identification
reset the analytical unit to one exact final deidentified text
reapply deduplication and fail on direct-locator findings

restricted: Production literal dictionaries, source adapters, title strings, per-title decisions, and audit rows.
